name: lora-dataset-studio
description: Curate image + caption datasets for Stable Diffusion LoRA training.

loraDataset.concurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous image reads/decodes (thumbnails, header reads).

loraDataset.thumbnailSize.description: Default tile size in the gallery (px). Adjustable per panel with the slider or Ctrl+wheel.

loraDataset.thumbnailResolution.description: Long side (px) of cached thumbnails. Changing it regenerates thumbnails.

loraDataset.cacheSizeLimitMB.description: Thumbnail disk cache limit. Oldest thumbnails are removed when exceeded.

loraDataset.captionExtensions.description: Caption file extensions, in priority order. The first existing <basename><ext> is the image's caption.

loraDataset.minResolution.description: Short-side threshold (px) for the "below min resolution" filter.

loraDataset.quality.blurThreshold.description: Images whose sharpness (variance of the Laplacian of a 256 px grayscale copy) is below this are flagged as blurry. Raise it to flag more images.

loraDataset.quality.maxAspect.description: Images whose long side / short side exceeds this are flagged as extreme aspect.

loraDataset.quality.minWords.description: Captions with fewer words are flagged as short.

loraDataset.quality.maxTokens.description: Captions with more (approximate) CLIP tokens are flagged as long. 75 is the default limit; kohya's --max_token_length allows 150 or 225.

loraDataset.confirmDelete.description: Ask for confirmation before permanently deleting images and their caption files. Deleting folders always asks.

loraDataset.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Rescan open galleries every N seconds in addition to the file watcher (0 = off). Use for network drives or folders whose changes the watcher misses.

loraDataset.captionAutosave.description: Save caption edits automatically after a short pause.

loraDataset.snapMultiple.description: Default multiple that crop (and later resize) sizes are rounded down to. 1 = off.

enumDescriptions: Brush size in screen pixels: the brush looks the same size at any zoom.
loraDataset.brushSizeMode.description: Default brush size mode in the image editor.

loraDataset.editorBackup.description: Before overwriting an edited image the first time, keep the original as <name>.<ext>.bak next to it.

loraDataset.jpegQuality.description: Quality for JPEG/WebP images saved from the editor.

loraDataset.undoMemoryMB.description: Memory limit for the image editor's undo history; the oldest steps are dropped beyond it.

enumDescriptions: SmilingWolf/wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3: more accurate, slower, ~1.3 GB download.
loraDataset.tagger.model.description: WD Tagger v3 model for caption generation. Downloaded from huggingface.co on first use unless a model folder is set.

loraDataset.tagger.modelFolder.description: Folder containing model.onnx and selected_tags.csv of a WD tagger, used instead of downloading. Empty = download the model selected above.

loraDataset.tagger.excludeTags.description: Tags never written by the caption generator (case-insensitive; underscores and spaces are equivalent).

loraDataset.tagger.replaceUnderscores.description: Write generated tags with spaces instead of underscores (kaomoji such as ^_^ are kept).

loraDataset.tagger.triggerWord.description: Tag(s) put first in every generated caption, e.g. your LoRA trigger word. Comma-separated for several.

enumDescriptions: Leave images that already have a non-empty caption untouched.
Add generated tags that the caption does not have yet.
Replace the caption with the generated tags.
loraDataset.tagger.existingCaptions.description: Default for auto-captioning images that already have a caption. The Generate button in the detail view treats skip like append.

enumDescriptions: WebGPU when available, otherwise WebAssembly on the CPU.
WebAssembly on the CPU only (single thread).
